calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, fade the completed session's intraday return; larger values indicate a larger intraday decline and predict stronger next-session return. Computed only from completed OHLC data.

validation.regime_notes: Positive mean daily IC in every calendar regime tested: 2020 0.02988, 2021 0.05767, 2022 0.05686, 2023 0.04521, 2024 0.06036, 2025 0.05442, 2026 YTD 0.03781. Cross-asset sample is small; uncertainty should be interpreted conservatively.

metrics.library_correlation_provenance: Pooled Spearman/rank correlation from signal artifact against rev5 and mom20 proxies; exact library gate recomputation remains authoritative.
